property_summary: For any actor and any amount that is at most their deposited balance, CashOut must succeed and reduce the actor's recorded balance by exactly the amount when the call succeeds, so a nonzero balance left after a full-balance withdrawal indicates the strict-< mutant skipped the withdrawal.
change_summary: Relax the CashOut balance check from <= to <, allowing callers to withdraw exactly their entire balance only when it is nonzero.
